info.body_text:
As Emilie entered the house, she could hear the sound of running water coming from the bathroom. Curiosity getting the best of her, she quietly approached the door and peeped inside. To her surprise, she saw her sister's boyfriend standing under the shower, his silhouette outlined by the steam.



Join your sister's boyfriend in the shower
————
Join Sophia on the couch
